description: Domain batch analysis: one authority row per domain, up to 100 at once. FREE — no paid provider call, unlike get_domain_overview. `organicTraffic`, `organicKeywords`, `backlinks` and `referringDomains` are ALWAYS null on every row — batch mode never attempts the per-domain paid rank-overview call the single-domain overview makes, since fanning that out across many domains in one call is a materially bigger paid-provider commitment than anything else this codebase does in one request. `organicUnavailableReason` states this once for the whole response; use get_domain_overview for organic figures on one domain at a time. Malformed domain entries are dropped and counted in `skippedInvalid` rather than failing the whole call. `authorityUnavailableReason` is set only when the authority provider itself failed to answer — null authority on every row without it set means every domain was looked up and found unranked, not that nothing could be looked up.

domains.description: 1-100 domains or URLs, any mix. Malformed entries are dropped, not rejected — see skippedInvalid in the result.

includeSubdomains.description: Count subdomains as part of each domain. Defaults to false, unlike get_domain_overview's default true.

projectId.description: Required. The MisarSEO project ID to scope this call to. Get one from list_projects.

name: get_domain_batch
